title: FBI-UAP-D032, FD-302, “Slow-moving Objects,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record regarding a 2026 UAP sighting, containing heavy redactions of names and specific locations.

incidents.summary: A U.S. Government Special Agent observed two black objects using a thermal optical device after an RF detection alert.
behavior: moving together at the same speed
incidents.quote: He saw a black object in the sky. It was not moving fast.
